aulas.objetivo: Começar frases com maiúscula, usar I e nomes próprios corretamente e terminar com ponto.
aulas.foco: Capital letters; full stop; question mark
explicacao: Toda frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (.) ou ponto de interrogação (?): My name is Ana.
O pronome I (eu) é sempre maiúsculo: Tom and I are friends.
Nomes de pessoas, cidades, países, idiomas e dias da semana têm maiúscula: Pedro, Recife, Brazil, English, Monday.
Em inglês, a idade usa am/is/are, não have: I am nine (não I have nine years).

material.tarefa: Write about yourself. Say your name, how old you are and where you live. Write 10 words or more.
material.modelo: My name is Ana. I am nine. I live in Recife, in Brazil.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Escrevi meu nome e os países/cidades com maiúscula?

exercicios.q: Which sentence is written correctly?
op: I live in rio de Janeiro.
exercicios.exp: Frase começa com maiúscula e Japan também; a opção 1 tem rio minúsculo e a 4 começa com i minúsculo.

exercicios.q: We have English on monday. Write the day correctly: ___
exercicios.exp: Dias da semana têm maiúscula em inglês: Monday.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: My name is Ana and I am nine.
exercicios.exp: Em 'nine', o som é 'nain'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence needs a question mark (?) at the end?
exercicios.exp: Where do you live é uma pergunta, então termina com ?
Ordem: My name is + nome.

exercicios.q: Correct the mistake: 'I have ten years old.' → I ___ ten years old.
exercicios.exp: Em inglês a idade usa be: I am ten. Não se usa have.

exercicios.q: Responda com seu nome.
exercicios.frase: What is your name?
exercicios.exp: Comece com My name is... ou I am...

exercicios.q: Which one is correct?
exercicios.exp: Tom and I (sujeito) combina com are. Lembre: I é sempre maiúsculo.

exercicios.q: My friend is ten. ___ lives in Salvador. (ele)
exercicios.exp: He = ele. Depois do ponto, a nova frase começa com maiúscula.

aulas.titulo: I am, you are, he is
aulas.objetivo: Escrever frases simples sobre você e outras pessoas com o verbo be.
aulas.foco: Verb be: am / is / are; short forms
explicacao: I am (I'm), you are (you're), he is (he's), she is (she's), it is (it's), we/you/they are.
Para negar, coloque not: I am not tired. She isn't at school.
Em perguntas, o verbo vem antes: Are you ten? Is he your brother?
Não esqueça o verbo: She is happy (não She happy).

material.tarefa: Write about your best friend. Say his or her name, how old he or she is and where he or she is from. Write 12 words or more.
material.modelo: My best friend is Rafa. He is ten. He is from Curitiba and he is very funny.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei is/are em todas as frases (não esqueci o verbo)?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
exercicios.exp: She combina com is, e o verbo não pode faltar.

exercicios.q: My brothers ___ at school now.
exercicios.exp: Brothers é plural (they), então usamos are.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: He is my friend and she is my sister.
exercicios.exp: Em 'she is' o som é 'chi iz'.

exercicios.q: Which short form is correct for 'They are'?
exercicios.exp: They are vira They're, com apóstrofo no lugar do a.
Pergunta com be: Are + you + ...

exercicios.q: My mum isn't at work. She ___ at home. (use the verb be)
exercicios.exp: She is (She's) at home: she combina com is.

exercicios.q: Diga como você está hoje.
exercicios.frase: How are you today?
exercicios.modelo: I am fine, thank you. I am a little tired.
exercicios.exp: Use I am (I'm) + adjetivo: I'm fine.

exercicios.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
exercicios.exp: They é plural: They are my teachers.

exercicios.q: Tom is ill. He ___ at school today. (forma negativa)
exercicios.exp: Is not = isn't.

aulas.objetivo: Falar de família e coisas que temos com have got / has got.
aulas.foco: have got / has got; possessive 's; my, your, his, her
explicacao: Com I, you, we, they: have got. Com he, she, it: has got. I have got a sister. She has got two dogs.
Para negar: haven't got / hasn't got. Para perguntar: Have you got a bike?
's mostra posse: Ana's brother = o irmão da Ana. Pronomes: my, your, his, her.
Cuidado: com has o verbo não leva -s de novo: She has got (não She has gots).

material.tarefa: Write about your family. Say who is in your family and what pet you have got. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: I have got a big family. I have got two sisters and one brother. We have got a small dog. Her name is Mel.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei have got para eu/nós e has got para ele/ela?

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
op: My sister have got a cat.
My sister has got a cat.
My sister has gots a cat.
My sister haves got a cat.
exercicios.exp: Com he/she/it usamos has got.

exercicios.q: I ___ got two brothers.
exercicios.exp: Com I usamos have got.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: My dad has got a red car and my mum has got a bike.
exercicios.exp: 'Has' tem o h aspirado: 'hãz'.

exercicios.q: 'This is Ana's dog.' What does 's mean?
op: Ana has a dog and a cat
exercicios.exp: 's mostra posse: o cachorro da Ana.

exercicios.resp: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
exercicios.exp: Pergunta: Have + you + got + ...

exercicios.q: My grandma ___ got a big garden and a yellow house.
exercicios.exp: Grandma = she, então has got.

exercicios.q: Diga quantos irmãos ou irmãs você tem.
exercicios.frase: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, I have got one sister. Her name is Lia.
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is about his family?
op: His mother has got a new job.
He's mother has got a new job.
Him mother has got a new job.
Hes mother has got a new job.
exercicios.exp: His é o pronome para 'dele'. He's é he is.

exercicios.q: My brother ___ got a pet. He doesn't like animals. (negative, short)
exercicios.exp: Negativa de he: hasn't got.

aulas.objetivo: Descrever objetos e pessoas com adjetivos na ordem certa.
explicacao: Em inglês o adjetivo vem ANTES do substantivo: a red bag (não a bag red).
O adjetivo não muda no plural: two red bags, three big dogs.
Use a antes de consoante e an antes de vogal: a big bag, an orange hat.
Para vários adjetivos: tamanho antes de cor: a small blue cap.

material.tarefa: Write about your favourite toy or thing. Say what it is, what colour it is and how big it is. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: My favourite thing is my bike. It is a new red bike. It is not very big, but it is fast.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Coloquei os adjetivos antes do substantivo (a red bike)?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct order.
exercicios.exp: Adjetivo antes do substantivo: a blue bag.

exercicios.q: I've got ___ orange hat. (a / an)
exercicios.exp: Orange começa com som de vogal, então an.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: She has got long black hair and a small red bag.
exercicios.exp: 'Hair' = 'hér'. 'Bag' = 'bég'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
exercicios.exp: O adjetivo vem antes e não muda no plural: two red bags.

exercicios.resp: It is a small green frog.
exercicios.exp: Ordem: tamanho + cor + substantivo.

exercicios.q: My cat has got a ___ tail. (comprido)
exercicios.exp: Long = comprido; short = curto.

exercicios.q: Descreva sua mochila ou estojo.
exercicios.frase: What colour is your bag?
exercicios.modelo: My bag is big and blue. It is new.
exercicios.exp: Use My bag is + cor.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is better for a picture of a big brown dog?
op: It is a brown big dog.
It is a big brown dog.
It is a dog big brown.
It is big a brown dog.
exercicios.exp: Tamanho antes da cor: a big brown dog.

exercicios.q: Look at Tom: he has got short brown ___. (cabelo)
exercicios.exp: Hair é incontável: short brown hair (sem -s).

aulas.objetivo: Descrever um lugar dizendo o que existe nele.
aulas.foco: There is / There are; some, a, any; in, on, under, next to
explicacao: There is + singular: There is a lamp on the desk. There are + plural: There are two books on the bed.
Negativa: There isn't a TV. There aren't any chairs.
Lugares: in (dentro), on (em cima), under (embaixo), next to (ao lado de), behind (atrás de).
Não escreva 'Has a table': em inglês, para existir, use There is / There are.

material.tarefa: Write about your bedroom. Say what there is in your room and where things are. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: There is a bed next to the window. There is a desk and a lamp. There are many books on the desk and a ball under the bed.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei there is com uma coisa e there are com várias?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
op: Has a lamp on the desk.
There has a lamp on the desk.
There is a lamp on the desk.
There are a lamp on the desk.
exercicios.exp: Para existir em inglês: There is + singular.

exercicios.q: There ___ three books on the table.
exercicios.exp: Three books é plural, então There are.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: There is a ball under the bed and two books on the desk.
exercicios.exp: Em 'there is', o 'th' tem a língua entre os dentes.

exercicios.q: Look: a cat is INSIDE a box. Which sentence is correct?
op: The cat is on the box.
The cat is in the box.
The cat is under the box.
The cat is next the box.
exercicios.exp: In = dentro.

exercicios.resp: There aren't any chairs in the kitchen.
exercicios.exp: Negativa no plural: There aren't any + substantivo.

exercicios.q: There ___ a TV in my bedroom. (forma negativa)
exercicios.exp: Negativa no singular: There isn't a TV.

exercicios.q: Diga o que há no seu quarto.
exercicios.frase: What is there in your bedroom?
exercicios.modelo: There is a bed and a desk. There are some books.
exercicios.exp: Comece com There is / There are.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is NOT correct?
op: There are two windows in the kitchen.
There is a cat next to the door.
There is five apples on the plate.
exercicios.exp: Five apples é plural: There are five apples.

exercicios.q: There is a ball ___ to the chair. (ao lado)
exercicios.exp: Next to = ao lado de.

aulas.objetivo: Escrever sobre a rotina do dia com o present simple.
aulas.foco: Present simple (I / he / she); -s and -es; time expressions
explicacao: Usamos o present simple para rotina: I get up at seven. We have lunch at school.
Com he, she, it, o verbo ganha -s: She gets up. Com go, watch, teach e brush: -es (goes, watches, teaches, brushes).
Para negar: don't (I, you, we, they) e doesn't (he, she, it) + verbo sem -s: He doesn't eat fish.
Horas: at seven o'clock, at half past eight. Depois de doesn't o verbo fica sem -s.

material.tarefa: Write about your school day. Say what time you get up, what you have for breakfast and how you go to school. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: I get up at half past six. I have bread and milk for breakfast. Then I go to school by bus with my sister.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei -s ou -es com he/she (She goes, He gets)?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
op: My brother get up at six.
My brother gets up at six.
My brother getting up at six.
My brother gots up at six.
exercicios.exp: Com he/she/it o verbo ganha -s: gets.

exercicios.q: I ___ breakfast at seven o'clock. (have)
exercicios.exp: Com I usamos o verbo na forma base: I have breakfast.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I get up at half past six and I brush my teeth.
exercicios.exp: 'Teeth' = 'tiif'; 'half' = 'háf' (o l é mudo).

exercicios.q: What time is it? 7:30
exercicios.exp: 7:30 = half past seven. O'clock só é usado para horas em ponto.

exercicios.resp: She goes to school by bus.
exercicios.exp: Com she, go vira goes.

exercicios.q: My brother ___ eat eggs. He doesn't like them. (negative)
exercicios.exp: Com he usamos doesn't + verbo sem -s.

exercicios.q: Diga a que horas você acorda.
exercicios.frase: What time do you get up?
exercicios.modelo: I get up at seven o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Use I get up at + hora.

exercicios.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
op: My dad doesn't works on Sunday.
exercicios.exp: Depois de doesn't o verbo fica sem -s: doesn't work.

exercicios.q: My mum ___ English at a big school. (teach)
exercicios.exp: Verbos terminados em -ch ganham -es: teaches.

aulas.titulo: Days, times and places: at, on, in
aulas.objetivo: Usar at, on e in com horas, dias e lugares em frases curtas.
aulas.foco: Prepositions at / on / in; days of the week
explicacao: At para horas: at six, at noon. On para dias: on Monday, on Saturday morning. In para partes do dia: in the morning, in the evening.
At night (à noite), mas in the evening. Também: in July, in summer.
Lugares: at school, at home, in the park, in my bag.
Brasileiros costumam trocar: escreva on Sunday (não in Sunday) e at home (não in home).

material.tarefa: Write about your weekend. Say what you do on Saturday and on Sunday. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: On Saturday morning I play football in the park. In the afternoon I visit my grandma. On Sunday I stay at home.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei on com os dias, in com manhã/tarde e at com horas?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
exercicios.exp: Dias da semana usam on.

exercicios.q: We have lunch ___ twelve o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Horas usam at: at twelve o'clock.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: On Sunday morning we go to the park.
exercicios.exp: 'Sunday' = 'sândei'; 'morning' = 'mórnin'.

exercicios.q: Which is correct?
exercicios.exp: Partes do dia usam in the: in the morning, in the evening.

exercicios.resp: I stay at home on Sunday afternoon.
exercicios.exp: Home usa at; dia e parte do dia: on Sunday afternoon.
alt: On Sunday afternoon I stay at home.

exercicios.q: My cousin visits us ___ July. (julho)
exercicios.exp: Meses usam in: in July.

exercicios.q: Diga o que você faz no sábado.
exercicios.frase: What do you do on Saturday?
exercicios.modelo: On Saturday I play with my friends in the park.
exercicios.exp: Comece com On Saturday I...

exercicios.q: Which sentence is NOT correct?
op: She is at school on Monday.
They play in the park at four o'clock.
He goes to bed in night.
We eat dinner in the evening.
exercicios.exp: A forma correta é at night.

exercicios.q: I do my homework ___ the afternoon on Tuesday. Write the missing word.
exercicios.exp: Partes do dia usam in: in the afternoon; já on Tuesday usa on.

aulas.objetivo: Dizer do que você gosta e não gosta, com like + palavra ou verbo com -ing.
aulas.foco: like / love / don't like + noun or -ing; because (intro)
explicacao: I like pizza. I love dogs. I don't like fish. Com he/she: She likes tea. She doesn't like fish.
Depois de like, love e don't like, você pode usar -ing: I like swimming. He loves playing games.
Em perguntas: Do you like apples? Does she like football? Resposta: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
Cuidado: não diga 'I like of pizza'. Em inglês, não existe 'of' depois de like.

material.tarefa: Write about the food and the sport you like. Say one thing you like and one thing you don't like. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: I like pizza and ice cream. I love playing football with my friends. I don't like fish, and I don't like swimming.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei like/love e don't like com o -ing quando falei de atividades?

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
exercicios.exp: Like é verbo direto: I like pizza.

exercicios.q: My sister ___ apples. (likes / like)
exercicios.exp: Com she o verbo ganha -s: likes.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I love swimming, but I don't like cold water.
exercicios.exp: 'Water' em inglês britânico: 'uóta'.

exercicios.q: Which answer is correct for 'Does your dad like fish?'
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta repete o auxiliar: Yes, he does.

exercicios.resp: She doesn't like playing computer games.
exercicios.exp: Depois de doesn't, like fica sem -s e vem o verbo com -ing.

exercicios.q: He loves ___ pictures. (draw)
exercicios.exp: Depois de love, o verbo ganha -ing: drawing.

exercicios.q: Diga uma comida de que você gosta.
exercicios.frase: What food do you like?
exercicios.modelo: I like pasta and chocolate. I don't like fish.
exercicios.exp: Use I like + comida.

exercicios.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
exercicios.exp: A negativa é doesn't like: My brother doesn't like tea.

exercicios.q: Tom ___ like cold milk. He prefers hot milk. (negative)
exercicios.exp: Com Tom (he), a negativa é doesn't.

aulas.objetivo: Falar do que sabemos e não sabemos fazer com can e can't.
aulas.foco: can / can't + base verb; questions with Can ...?
explicacao: Can mostra capacidade: I can swim. She can play the piano.
Can não muda e o verbo seguinte fica sem to e sem -s: He can run (não He cans runs / can to run).
Negativa: can't (cannot). Pergunta: Can you ride a bike? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Depois de can use o verbo base: Can you help me?

material.tarefa: Write about what you can do and what you can't do. Say two things you can do and one thing you can't do. Write 15 words or more.
material.modelo: I can swim and I can ride a bike. I can't sing very well, but I can play the guitar. My brother can cook.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei can/can't + verbo sem to e sem -s?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
exercicios.exp: Can + verbo base, sem -s e sem to.

exercicios.q: My little brother ___ read yet. He is only three. (negative, short)
exercicios.exp: Can't = não consegue.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I can swim very well, but I can't ride a bike.
exercicios.exp: 'Can't' em inglês britânico: 'cant' com a longo. 'Can' é curto: 'kən'.

exercicios.q: Which question is correct?
exercicios.exp: Pergunta com can: Can + you + verbo.

exercicios.resp: Can your sister play the piano?
exercicios.exp: Can vem antes do sujeito na pergunta.

exercicios.q: Yes, I can. I can speak English ___ a little Spanish. (e)
exercicios.exp: And liga duas coisas.

exercicios.q: Diga uma coisa que você sabe fazer.
exercicios.frase: What can you do well?
exercicios.modelo: I can play football and I can draw.
exercicios.exp: Use I can + verbo.

exercicios.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
exercicios.exp: Depois de can o verbo fica sem -s: She can play.

exercicios.q: The door is locked. I can't ___ it. (abrir)
exercicios.exp: Depois de can't vem o verbo base, sem to e sem -ing: I can't open it.

aulas.titulo: Joining ideas with and, but, or
aulas.objetivo: Ligar duas frases curtas em uma com and, but e or.
aulas.foco: Linking words: and, but, or; commas
explicacao: And junta ideias iguais: I like tea and cake.
But mostra contraste: I like football, but I don't like tennis.
Or mostra escolha: Do you want tea or milk?
Quando and/but liga duas frases completas, ponha vírgula antes de but: I'm tired, but I'm happy.

material.tarefa: Write about your free time. Say one thing you like and one thing you don't like. Use and and but in your text. Write 18 words or more.
material.modelo: I like reading and I like drawing, but I don't like playing computer games. I sometimes watch TV or listen to music.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei and para juntar e but para contrastar?

exercicios.q: Which word is best? 'I like tea, ___ I don't like coffee.'
exercicios.exp: But mostra contraste entre gostar e não gostar.

exercicios.q: I have a dog ___ a cat. (e)
exercicios.exp: And liga dois itens parecidos.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I like reading, but I don't like writing.
exercicios.exp: Faça uma pequena pausa na vírgula antes de 'but'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is written correctly?
op: I am tired, but happy I am.
I am tired, but I am happy.
I am tired but, am happy.
I am tired, but I happy.
exercicios.exp: Duas frases completas ligadas por but: vírgula antes de but, e cada frase tem sujeito + verbo.

exercicios.resp: Do you want tea or milk?
exercicios.exp: Or oferece uma escolha entre duas opções.

exercicios.q: Ana can sing, ___ she can't dance. (mas)
exercicios.exp: But = mas.

exercicios.q: Diga uma coisa de que você gosta e uma de que não gosta.
exercicios.frase: What do you like and what don't you like?
exercicios.modelo: I like pizza, but I don't like fish.
exercicios.exp: Use but para ligar: I like..., but I don't like...

exercicios.q: Which sentence is best?
op: I am hungry, and I eat a sandwich.
I am hungry, so I eat a sandwich.
I am hungry, but I eat a sandwich.
I am hungry, or I eat a sandwich.
exercicios.exp: Para mostrar resultado, use so: Estou com fome, então como.

exercicios.q: It is sunny, ___ it is very cold. (but / and)
exercicios.exp: Sol e frio é um contraste: but.

aulas.objetivo: Explicar o motivo de uma opinião ou ação com because.
explicacao: Why...? pergunta o motivo. Because responde: Why do you like summer? Because I can swim.
Because liga duas ideias: I like dogs because they are friendly.
Depois de because vem uma frase completa, com sujeito e verbo: because he is tired (não because tired).
Não confunda because (porque) com but (mas) e so (então).

material.tarefa: Write about your favourite animal. Say what it is and why you like it. Use because. Write 18 words or more.
material.modelo: My favourite animal is the dog because it is friendly. I also like cats because they are soft, but I like dogs more.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei because com uma frase completa (sujeito + verbo)?

exercicios.q: Which word answers 'Why do you like Fridays?'
exercicios.exp: Why pede o motivo; a resposta começa com because.

exercicios.q: I like my teacher ___ she is funny. (porque)
exercicios.exp: Because = porque.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I like summer because I can swim every day.
exercicios.exp: 'Because' = 'bicóz'; 'summer' = 'sâma'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
op: I like dogs because they are friendly.
I like dogs because are friendly.
I like dogs because they friendly.
exercicios.exp: Depois de because vem sujeito + verbo: they are friendly.

exercicios.resp: I like pizza because it is tasty.
exercicios.exp: Ideia principal + because + motivo.

exercicios.q: Mum is happy ___ it is her birthday. (porque)
exercicios.exp: Because liga a emoção ao motivo.

exercicios.q: Diga por que você gosta do seu dia preferido.
exercicios.frase: Why do you like your favourite day?
exercicios.modelo: I like Saturday because I can play with my friends.
exercicios.exp: Responda com Because... ou I like ... because ...

exercicios.q: Choose the best sentence.
op: He is sad because it is raining and his picnic is cancelled.
He is sad because the rain.
He is sad because is rain.
exercicios.exp: Because + frase completa: it is raining.

exercicios.q: We stay at home today ___ it is cold. (because)
exercicios.exp: Mostra o motivo de ficar em casa.

aulas.titulo: Yesterday and last weekend: past simple
aulas.objetivo: Contar o que aconteceu no passado com verbos regulares e irregulares comuns.
aulas.foco: Past simple: was / were, regular -ed, go–went, have–had, see–saw
explicacao: Regulares ganham -ed: play → played, visit → visited, watch → watched. Com y: study → studied.
Irregulares comuns: go → went, have → had, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought.
Be no passado: I/he/she/it was; you/we/they were. Marcadores: yesterday, last Saturday, two days ago.
Negativa e pergunta usam did + verbo base: I didn't go. Did you play? (nunca 'didn't went').

material.tarefa: Write about last weekend. Say where you went and what you did there. Write 20 words or more.
material.modelo: Last Saturday I went to the beach with my family. We played football and I swam in the sea. In the evening we ate pizza.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Usei o passado em todos os verbos (went, played, had)?

exercicios.q: Choose the correct sentence.
op: Yesterday I go to the park.
Yesterday I went to the park.
Yesterday I goed to the park.
Yesterday I going to the park.
exercicios.exp: Go é irregular: went.

exercicios.q: Last night I ___ TV for two hours. (watch)
exercicios.exp: Regulares ganham -ed: watched.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Yesterday we went to the cinema and saw a funny film.
exercicios.exp: 'Went' = 'uént'; 'saw' = 'só'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
exercicios.exp: Depois de didn't o verbo volta ao normal: go.

exercicios.resp: We had lunch at my grandma's house.
exercicios.exp: Had = passado de have.

exercicios.q: My brother ___ at home yesterday. He was ill. (be)
exercicios.exp: Be no passado: I/he/she/it was.

exercicios.q: Diga o que você fez ontem.
exercicios.frase: What did you do yesterday?
exercicios.modelo: Yesterday I played football and I did my homework.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: played, went, did.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
exercicios.exp: Did + sujeito + verbo base: Did you see ...?

exercicios.q: They ___ a new bike two days ago. (buy)
exercicios.exp: Buy é irregular: bought.

aulas.objetivo: Escrever cartões de aniversário e cartões-postais curtos.
aulas.foco: Greetings; Happy birthday; wishes; postcards (I'm/we're, the weather)
explicacao: Cartão de aniversário: Dear + nome, Happy birthday!, uma frase de desejo e Love from + seu nome.
Desejos: I hope you have a great day. Have fun! Best wishes.
Cartão-postal: diga onde está e o que faz. Hello from Rio! The weather is hot and sunny. I'm swimming every day.
Termine com Love, ou See you soon! e seu nome. Use frases curtas.

material.tarefa: It is your friend Lucy's birthday. Write her a birthday card. Say happy birthday, say what present you have for her and say what you hope she does. Write 20 words or more.
material.modelo:
Dear Lucy,
Happy birthday! I have a small present for you. It is a book about horses. I hope you have a great day with your family.
Love from Bia
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Comecei com Dear + nome e terminei com Love from + meu nome?

exercicios.q: Which is the best beginning for a birthday card to Lucy?
exercicios.exp: Dear + nome é a abertura normal em cartões.

exercicios.q: Happy ___, Lucy! You are ten today. (aniversário)
exercicios.exp: Happy birthday! é a felicitação mais comum.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day.
exercicios.exp: 'Birthday' = 'bârthdei'; 'hope' = 'rôup'.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is best for a postcard from the beach?
op: Hello from the beach! The weather is hot and sunny.
I am the weather hot at beach.
exercicios.exp: Num cartão-postal, diga onde está e como está o tempo.

exercicios.resp: I hope you have a great day.
exercicios.exp: Hope + frase completa: I hope you have...

exercicios.q: Dear Grandma, thank you for my present. Love ___ Pedro
exercicios.exp: Love from + nome.

exercicios.q: Diga uma frase de felicitação para um amigo.
exercicios.frase: What do you say on a friend's birthday?
exercicios.modelo: Happy birthday! I hope you have a lovely day.
exercicios.exp: Comece com Happy birthday!

exercicios.q: Which sentence is a good ending for a postcard?
exercicios.exp: See you soon! Love, + nome é um final informal natural.

exercicios.q: Hello from London! The weather ___ cold, but the people are friendly. (be)
exercicios.exp: Weather é singular: the weather is.

aulas.objetivo: Escrever um bilhete curto com convite, hora, lugar e pedido.
aulas.foco: Please, would like, Can you ...?; time and place; Why don't we ...?
explicacao: Convite: Would you like to come to my party? / Can you come to my house on Saturday?
Dê informações: o quê, quando e onde: My party is on Saturday at four o'clock at my house.
Resposta: Yes, I'd love to! / Sorry, I can't. I'm busy.
Peça com please e agradeça com thank you: Please bring a ball. Thank you!

material.tarefa: You are having a small party on Saturday. Write a note to your friend Sam. In your note: invite Sam to the party, say the time and the place, and ask Sam to bring something. Write 20 words or more.
material.modelo:
Hi Sam,
Would you like to come to my party on Saturday? It is at four o'clock at my house. Please bring a ball for the games.
Bye for now,
Nico
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Convidei, disse hora e lugar e pedi para trazer algo?

exercicios.q: Which sentence is a polite invitation?
op: Would you like to come to my party?
exercicios.exp: Would you like to...? é um convite educado.

exercicios.q: My party is ___ Saturday at four o'clock. (sábado)
exercicios.exp: Dias da semana usam on.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: 'Would you' soa como 'uóju'.

exercicios.q: Which answer is a nice reply to an invitation, when you can't go?
op: Sorry, I can't. I'm busy on Saturday.
exercicios.exp: Sorry, I can't + motivo é uma resposta educada.

exercicios.resp: Can you bring a ball, please?
exercicios.exp: Please pode ficar no final, depois de vírgula.
alt: Can you please bring a ball?
Please can you bring a ball?

exercicios.q: Thank you ___ your invitation. I'd love to come! (por)
exercicios.exp: Thank you for + nome.

exercicios.q: Aceite um convite para uma festa.
exercicios.frase: Would you like to come to my party?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, I would love to come. Thank you for inviting me.
exercicios.exp: Yes, I'd love to! é a resposta natural.

exercicios.q: Which note is complete (what, when, where)?
op: My party is on Sunday at three o'clock at my house.
exercicios.exp: Tem o quê (party), quando (Sunday, three) e onde (my house).

exercicios.q: Please bring ___ ball and some water. (uma)
exercicios.exp: A ball = uma bola.

aulas.titulo: Mock test: pictures and a short story
aulas.objetivo: Fazer um simulado no formato da prova: completar frases, responder perguntas e escrever uma história curta.
aulas.foco: Movers/Flyers writing: sentences about pictures; short story of 20–40 words
explicacao: No simulado você faz exercícios parecidos com a prova: completar frases sobre uma figura, ordenar palavras, responder perguntas e escrever uma história curta.
Na história, conte em ordem: onde estavam, o que aconteceu e como terminou. Use went, saw, had, was e conectivos and, but, because, then.
Escreva frases curtas e completas, com maiúscula no início e ponto no final.
Releia no fim: verbos no passado, as palavras na ordem certa e a quantidade de palavras (20–40).

material.tarefa: Look at the three pictures. Picture 1: Sam and his dad are at the beach with a red kite. Picture 2: The kite is in a tree. Sam is sad. Picture 3: A girl has a ladder and Sam is happy. Write the story. Write 20 words or more.
material.modelo: Sam and his dad went to the beach on Saturday. They had a red kite, but the wind took it into a tree. Then a girl brought a ladder and helped them. Sam was happy.
checklist: Respondi a todos os pontos da tarefa?
Cada frase começa com letra maiúscula e termina com ponto (ou ?)?
Escrevi o número de palavras pedido?
Contei a história na ordem das três figuras?
Usei o passado (went, had, was) e conectivos (but, then)?

exercicios.q: Picture: a boy and a dog are in the park. Which sentence is best?
op: The boy and the dog is in the park.
The boy and the dog are in the park.
The boy and the dog in park.
The boy and the dog are on the park.
exercicios.exp: Dois sujeitos (the boy and the dog) pedem are; e in the park.

exercicios.q: Picture: a girl has a red bag. → The girl ___ a red bag. (has got / has)
exercicios.exp: Com she: has (got).

exercicios.q: Picture: a cat is sleeping under the table. Which sentence is correct?
op: The cat is under the table.
The cat is on the table.
The cat is next the table.
The cat under is the table.
exercicios.exp: Under = embaixo de.

exercicios.resp: There are three birds in the tree.
exercicios.exp: There are + plural + lugar.

exercicios.q: Leia a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Yesterday we went to the park and played with a red ball.
exercicios.exp: 'Played' = 'plêid'; 'went' = 'uént'.

exercicios.q: Last Sunday Tom ___ to the zoo with his uncle. (go)
exercicios.exp: Go é irregular: went.

exercicios.q: Which two sentences go best together in a story?
op: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
It was raining, so we goes to the park.
It was raining, but we stay home.
It rains, so we stayed at home.
exercicios.exp: Passado + conectivo so: It was raining, so we stayed at home.

exercicios.q: The boy is sad ___ he lost his kite. (porque)
exercicios.exp: Because dá o motivo.

exercicios.q: Conte em duas frases o que você fez no último fim de semana.
exercicios.frase: What did you do last weekend?
exercicios.modelo: Last weekend I went to the park with my cousin. We played football.
exercicios.exp: Use o passado: went, played, had.

exercicios.resp: Then a girl helped Sam and he was happy.
exercicios.exp: Then abre a frase; and liga as duas partes.
